- Step 1: write acceptance tests first in specs/test_artefacts/acceptance/test_e1_s2_audit.py (AC1-AC4), run record-at-red.js while red; unit/API tests in backend/tests/api/test_audit.py and backend/tests/repo/test_audit_repo.py
- Step 2: add record/list functions (insert uses caller's connection and transaction, UTC occurred_at from Clock, no commit) in backend/src/truelend/repository/audit_repo.py
- Step 3: add GET /api/audit (ADMIN only via require_roles, filters entity_type/entity_id/action, ascending id, {items,total,limit,offset}) in backend/src/truelend/api/audit_router.py
- Step 4: register the audit router in backend/src/truelend/api/main.py; env=test only audited route for AC1/AC4 so success commits row and 409 rolls back with the action
- Step 5: remove the xfail on test_e1_s1_ac4_customer_forbidden_on_audit in backend/tests/api/test_auth.py and drop audit-check bookkeeping
